title.text: Agent TUI (OpenTUI + Solid) — the #16 console, in the terminal

arch.text:
How it fits
• A separate client: `pnpm tui <console link>` (or TASKFAST_CONSOLE_URL). It talks to the host's console API from PR #17 over 127.0.0.1 with the same token. It never opens a store or an event stream, same as the web page.
• OpenTUI's Solid renderer needs Bun (README: `bun index.tsx`, bunfig preload `@opentui/solid/preload`; native core in Zig). The host stays on Node 24, so Bun becomes a dev/tool dependency for the TUI only.
• Built from OpenTUI elements: <box> panels with titles, <scrollbox> timeline, <input> message line, <textarea>/<select> in Briefing, <tab_select> for tabs; keys via useKeyboard; layout follows useTerminalDimensions.
• Same data and actions as the web console: timeline, alerts, readiness, tasks, spend, orders, pause, freeze, message, mark checked, run again, save & reopen.

keys.text:
Keys
1 / 2  Timeline / Briefing
j k  move between replies · g G top / bottom
enter  show / hide the reply's tool calls
r  raw event (on an event turn)
o  open the task link (OSC 8 hyperlink, else print the URL)
m  focus the message line · enter sends · esc leaves
p  pause / resume · f freeze (asks y/n) / unfreeze
c  mark checked · R run again (on an alert)
Tab  next panel · ? help · q quit
Mouse: click badges, scroll the timeline.

open.text:
Choices to approve
1. Separate Bun client of the PR #17 API (recommended) vs. running the TUI inside the Node host (not possible: OpenTUI Solid needs Bun).
2. Polling every 2 s, like the web page, vs. adding a server-sent event stream to the console API first.
3. Freeze and Save ask y/n in the TUI; pause does not.
4. Below 100 columns the sidebar folds away (i toggles it), screen 5.
